entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that performs cell selection and reselection procedures.

entities.name: Cell Selection/Reselection
entities.description: The procedure where the UE searches for and selects a suitable cell to camp on according to 3GPP TS 36.304 specifications.

entities.name: No Cell Available Condition
entities.description: Condition indicating that no suitable cell is available for the UE to camp on.

relations.description: The no cell available condition triggers the UE to perform cell selection/reselection procedure.
The UE performs cell selection/reselection procedure when no cell is available.
